title: Verify package migration with the retained walking controller
summary: We removed 37 flat wrappers and verified the migrated packages. The unchanged c48_long checkpoint passed 13/13 probes through both the parity harness and the certified production loader, with matching contact and torque measurements. We completed standing admission at 1/32/128 robots; the requester stopped 512 and deferred 1024.
next: Use package commands and the certified receipt for c48_long evaluation. Renew 512-robot admission before fresh 512-robot training packs.
reason: This migration preserves the existing controller result and acceptance gates. It adds no walking qualification or physics change.
